newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.04 down at 41.19 to the dollar in kerb on Saturday amid rising demand for the U.S. currency and is likely to fall further in the next few sessions, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to remain weak as dollar was in demand after newspapers on Friday quoted Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz as saying that a marginal devaluation was likely.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.70 percent, from Friday's close at 2.60 percent.- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
